composite.provenance_note: Confirmed this session: settings.json:1104-1109 literally contains ranking_weights with these three values, and _weights() (advisor_engine.py:35-39) merges config over defaults -- config is the operative source, not the code fallback. The two happen to be numerically identical because someone kept them in sync.

fundamentals_category.sum_note: floating point artifact of summing 6 decimal literals, not a config error

market_behavior_subweights.champion_path_override: settings.json top-level short_horizon_treatment='neutral' causes technical_score_from_parts (advisor_engine.py:207-234) to drop relative_strength and renormalize the remaining 6 weights (sum 0.90) to 1.0 for the LIVE champion score. Nominal 0.16 weight above is not what applies on the champion path.

timeliness_subweights.note: shadow-path only; earnings_surprise here is a DIFFERENT transform of the same raw field used at fundamentals.growth weight 0.16

sector_valuation.bound: +/-3, step function (full cap for cheapest/most-expensive third, 0 for middle third)

short_interest.bound: up to -6 (-6 at >=15% float short, -3 at >=8%, plus up to -1.5 more for days-to-cover >=5, capped at -6 total)

expectations.bound: +/-3 (two independent +/-1.5 legs -- upside and rating -- summed and clamped to +/-3)

macro_regime.bound: +/-3 hard cap; points=(sector_score-50)/50*3, naturally bounded since sector_score in [0,100]

institutional_13f.bound: +3 / -2 (asymmetric); confirmed LIVE in the champion path, wired directly into apply_modifiers at advisor_engine.py:539

customer_concentration_risk.bound: -3 to 0 (penalty-only, ceilinged at 0.0); confirmed LIVE in the champion path at advisor_engine.py:545
customer_concentration_risk.note: settings.json's own _comment on this modifier claims it is SHADOW MODE ONLY (apply_challenger_modifiers) -- that comment is STALE; the code (advisor_engine.py:545, inside apply_modifiers) and the module docstring both confirm it is live in the champion path as of Phase 3.3

combined_cap_challenger_modifier_recalib.note: allocates each modifier a FRACTION of the 20-point cap, a distinct non-champion scoring path

worked_example_effective_weights.formula: 0.78 * category_weight * metric_weight for fundamentals; 0.18 * sub_weight for market_behavior

defaults.behavior: ev_to_sales is absent from EXTENDED_METRIC_UNITS so it has no canonical Observation lineage; the shadow path therefore aliases sales_multiple to price_to_sales ONLY, never the EV-based value the legacy score actually preferred when available

metrics.name: ev_to_ebitda
metrics.formula_as_implemented: EV / TTM_EBITDA if EBITDA>0; EV=info.enterpriseValue or market_cap+total_debt-cash; result discarded if EV/denominator > 500 (scale-mismatch guard)
metrics.period_convention: UNDETERMINED (annual statements consumed; is_ttm=False on the Observation despite EBITDA being economically TTM-like)
metrics.normalization: bands (fixed absolute thresholds, no reference population)
metrics.missing_value_behavior: excluded from category weight base (weighted_available renormalizes)
metrics.display_tooltip: Whole-company price against operating profit - debt included. The best-validated single value multiple in the published research

metrics.name: ev_to_fcf
metrics.formula_as_implemented: EV / TTM_FCF (FCF from cashflow.free_cash_flow or operating_cash_flow-capex); denominator must be positive
metrics.display_tooltip: Whole-company price against actual cash generated

metrics.name: forward_pe
metrics.formula_as_implemented: price / next-fiscal-year consensus diluted EPS (raw Yahoo forwardPE field, not independently recomputed)
metrics.fallback_chain: provider_reconciliation.json: [calculated_from_canonical_inputs, alpha_vantage, yahoo], 5% discrepancy tolerance, flag_and_use_preferred
metrics.normalization: bands, sector-specific cutoff table (6 sectors + default)
metrics.display_tooltip: Price against next year's earnings
metrics.note: champion/shadow suppression-surface divergence: metric_registry.json's applicability_profiles omits profitable_biotechnology/semiconductor, relevant only to the shadow path's applicability_for registry fallback; the legacy suppressed_metrics() function never consults this registry at all

metrics.name: ev_to_ebit
metrics.formula_as_implemented: EV / TTM_EBIT (EBIT from income statement); same EV construction as ev_to_ebitda
metrics.display_tooltip: The same multiple without the depreciation add-back, so capital intensity cannot hide in it

metrics.name: peg
metrics.formula_as_implemented: legacy score bands raw Yahoo trailingPegRatio (diagnostic only); canonical/shadow path computes forward_pe/growth_points from explicit forward inputs only, clamped [-20,50], rejecting on bad period/definition/nonpositive growth

code_reference.computed_at: canonical_metrics.py:81-92 (calculate_peg, canonical); canonical_metrics.py:249 (raw diagnostic yahoo field)

metrics.fallback_chain: none for canonical PEG (rejects rather than substitutes)
metrics.period_convention: forward, matched-horizon required for canonical PEG
metrics.missing_value_behavior: excluded from category weight base; canonical peg additionally rejects (not substitutes) on validation failure
metrics.display_tooltip: Growth-adjusted earnings multiple
metrics.note: legacy fundamental_detail.peg and analysis_v2 canonical_metrics.peg can legitimately differ (scoring_v2.py:89-96)

metrics.name: sales_multiple
metrics.formula_as_implemented: prefers EV/Sales (sector-banded); falls back to P/S trailing-12m (sector-banded) if EV/Sales unavailable
metrics.period_convention: TTM for price_to_sales basis (is_ttm=True); UNDETERMINED for ev_to_sales basis
metrics.display_label: not shown as 'sales_multiple' -- UI shows ev_to_sales / price_to_sales directly
metrics.note: ev_to_sales absent from EXTENDED_METRIC_UNITS -> no Observation lineage -> shadow path aliases this metric to price_to_sales only, a champion/shadow basis mismatch found this session

metrics.name: price_to_book
metrics.formula_as_implemented: market_cap / common_equity (raw Yahoo priceToBook field)
metrics.missing_value_behavior: REQUIRED for score for 4 profiles: absence zeroes the whole valuation category (not renormalized)
metrics.display_tooltip: Price against reported book value

metrics.name: price_to_tangible_book
metrics.formula_as_implemented: market_cap / (equity - goodwill - intangibles)
metrics.missing_value_behavior: REQUIRED for score for bank (zeroes valuation category); otherwise renormalized away
suppressed_for_profiles: sectors NOT in TANGIBLE_BOOK_SECTORS and NOT naming it a replacement_metric -- code-level gate, not a config table
metrics.display_tooltip: Book value with goodwill stripped out - the honest one for financials

metrics.name: return_on_invested_capital
metrics.formula_as_implemented: NOPAT / avg(invested_capital); NOPAT=EBIT*(1-tax_rate); invested_capital=debt+equity-cash; tax_rate defaults to 0.21 if computed rate outside [0,0.6]
metrics.fallback_chain: none configured; tax rate falls back to 0.21 statutory literal
metrics.display_tooltip: Return on every dollar of capital, debt and equity alike

metrics.name: gross_profits_to_assets
metrics.formula_as_implemented: gross_profit / avg(total_assets); gross_profit falls back to revenue-cost_of_revenue if not separately reported
metrics.display_tooltip: Profitability measured above the line where accounting discretion operates - about as predictive as book-to-market, and complementary to it

metrics.name: free_cash_flow_yield
metrics.formula_as_implemented: freeCashflow / marketCap (raw Yahoo quote-level fields)
metrics.display_tooltip: Free cash flow against market value

metrics.name: cash_conversion
metrics.formula_as_implemented: FCF / net_income, requires net_income > 0 else None
metrics.missing_value_behavior: excluded from category weight base; also rejects (None) rather than divides by non-positive net income
metrics.display_tooltip: Free cash flow per dollar of reported net income

metrics.name: return_on_equity
metrics.formula_as_implemented: raw Yahoo returnOnEquity field, no recomputation
metrics.display_tooltip: Return on shareholder equity only - flattered by debt

metrics.name: profit_margin
metrics.formula_as_implemented: raw Yahoo profitMargins field, no recomputation
metrics.display_tooltip: Bottom-line profit per dollar of revenue
metrics.note: dual role: also the sole input deciding pre_profit_biotechnology/other_pre_profit business-profile classification

metrics.name: interest_coverage
metrics.formula_as_implemented: EBIT / |interest_expense|; imputed to 99.0 when interest is None or |interest|<1 and EBIT>0

code_reference.also_used_at: advisor_engine.py:740-744 (action_for, raw <2x threshold test, different cutoff than the 0-100 band)

metrics.fallback_chain: imputes 99.0 literal on near-zero/absent interest expense
metrics.display_tooltip: Operating profit per dollar of interest owed

metrics.name: net_debt_to_ebitda
metrics.formula_as_implemented: (total_debt - cash) / EBITDA, requires EBITDA > 0
metrics.missing_value_behavior: excluded from category weight base (lower_is_better_score never penalizes a negative reading, e.g. net cash)
metrics.display_tooltip: Years of operating profit needed to clear net debt

metrics.name: debt_to_equity
metrics.formula_as_implemented: Yahoo debtToEquity field divided by 100 (Yahoo reports as a percentage where 80 means 0.8x)
metrics.missing_value_behavior: REQUIRED for score for 4 profiles: absence zeroes financial_health category
metrics.display_tooltip: Leverage against book equity

metrics.name: altman_z
metrics.formula_as_implemented: variant-dependent weighted sum of 4-5 balance-sheet ratios; z (manufacturing, 5 terms) or z_double_prime (non-manufacturer, 4 terms) chosen by sector; financials get (None,None) unconditionally
metrics.fallback_chain: none; requires >=4/5 (z) or >=3/4 (z'') component ratios else None
suppressed_for_profiles: any Financial-sector name (derivation-layer suppression, independent of profile)
metrics.display_tooltip: Composite bankruptcy risk, computed with the variant fitted for this sector - the original manufacturing model or Altman's non-manufacturer revision. Suppressed for financials, where it has no meaning

metrics.name: current_ratio
metrics.formula_as_implemented: raw Yahoo currentRatio field
metrics.display_tooltip: Short-term assets against short-term bills

metrics.name: revenue_growth
metrics.formula_as_implemented: raw Yahoo revenueGrowth field
metrics.source_field: revenueGrowth (aliased to trailing_revenue_growth in shadow path)
suppressed_for_profiles: shadow-path-only: bank/property_casualty_insurer/life_insurer/diversified_insurer/reit/profitable_biotechnology (via trailing_revenue_growth's own registry applicability_profiles, registry-fallback divergence from legacy path -- champion path never suppresses this)
metrics.display_tooltip: Year-over-year revenue change

metrics.name: fcf_growth_3y
metrics.formula_as_implemented: CAGR of free cash flow across every annual period on file (typically 3-4y), requires >=3 periods
metrics.display_tooltip: Compound annual free-cash-flow growth

metrics.name: earnings_growth
metrics.formula_as_implemented: raw Yahoo earningsGrowth field, flagged not_forward_growth
metrics.source_field: earningsGrowth (aliased to trailing_eps_growth in shadow path)
metrics.period_convention: UNDETERMINED (quarterly-flavored per internal field name quarterly_eps_growth, not_forward_growth flag)
metrics.display_tooltip: Year-over-year earnings change

metrics.name: operating_margin_trend
metrics.formula_as_implemented: current_operating_margin - prior_operating_margin
metrics.display_tooltip: Year-over-year change - direction beats level

metrics.name: earnings_surprise
metrics.formula_as_implemented: weighted avg of last 4 quarters' surprise%, weights [0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1] newest-first
metrics.source_field: derived from yfinance earnings_dates surprise column
metrics.display_tooltip: Recent quarters against expectations, newest weighted heaviest. Beating expectations carries drift in a way trailing growth alone does not
metrics.note: same raw field also scored via a second, unrelated formula in the shadow timeliness layer -- see the separate 'earnings_surprise_timeliness' entry

metrics.name: net_buyback_yield
metrics.formula_as_implemented: -(diluted_shares_now/diluted_shares_prior - 1); positive means net share-count shrink
metrics.fallback_chain: diluted_shares (income statement) falls back for shares_outstanding (balance sheet) if <2 balance-sheet periods
metrics.display_tooltip: Share count change over the year, net of dilution - positive means your stake grew

metrics.name: stock_comp_to_revenue
metrics.formula_as_implemented: |stock_comp| / revenue
metrics.display_tooltip: The dilution cost GAAP earnings hide

metrics.name: capex_to_depreciation
metrics.formula_as_implemented: |capex| / |depreciation|
metrics.display_tooltip: Under 1x flatters near-term cash flow and starves the business

metrics.name: asset_growth
metrics.formula_as_implemented: total_assets_now/total_assets_prior - 1
metrics.direction: ideal_range (both fast and slow growth penalized; ideal [-0.02,0.12], acceptable [-0.12,0.25])
metrics.display_tooltip: Total balance-sheet expansion year over year. Aggressive growth has historically preceded weak returns, and shrinking is not a virtue either

metrics.name: piotroski_f
metrics.formula_as_implemented: 9-point binary composite (Piotroski 2000), rescaled to 9*sum(answered)/len(answered) if >=6 of 9 tests resolve, else None
metrics.fallback_chain: none configured; partial-coverage rescaling is itself a quasi-imputation
metrics.missing_value_behavior: excluded from category weight base if <6 of 9 tests answer
metrics.display_tooltip: Nine-point fundamental-strength composite, and the one earnings-quality signal that still validates well

metrics.name: accruals_ratio
metrics.formula_as_implemented: (net_income - operating_cash_flow) / avg(total_assets)
metrics.display_tooltip: Net income minus operating cash flow, over assets - negative is healthy

metrics.name: days_sales_outstanding_trend
metrics.formula_as_implemented: DSO_now/DSO_prior - 1, where DSO = (receivables/revenue)*365
metrics.display_tooltip: Rising receivable days can mean revenue booked ahead of cash

metrics.name: inventory_days_trend
metrics.formula_as_implemented: inventory_days_now/inventory_days_prior - 1, where inventory_days = (inventory/cost_of_revenue)*365
metrics.display_tooltip: Rising inventory days is the retail and industrial version of the same warning

metrics.name: momentum_12_1
metrics.formula_as_implemented: (close[-21]/close[-253]-1)*100 (12-month return skipping most recent month); score=clamp(50+momentum*1.2); falls back to return_60d if <253 closes
metrics.normalization: fixed linear map (clamp(50+x*1.2)), no reference population
metrics.display_tooltip: Twelve-month return excluding the most recent month, the standard construction - the skipped month is dominated by short-term reversal
metrics.note: display label/tooltip shown are for the RAW momentum_12_1_pct field (MetricSections.jsx), not the 0-100 composite sub-score, which has no dedicated UI label found

metrics.name: risk_adjusted
metrics.formula_as_implemented: 0.65*ratio_to_score(Sortino) + 0.35*ratio_to_score(Sharpe); ratio_to_score: neutral=0,span=1.5 -> 0->50, 1.5->75, 3.0->87.5
metrics.fallback_chain: uses whichever of Sortino/Sharpe resolves if not both
metrics.normalization: fixed saturating curve, no reference population
metrics.display_label: Sortino ratio / Sharpe ratio (raw inputs shown, not the composite score)
metrics.display_tooltip: Return per unit of downside deviation - upside volatility is not a risk worth penalising (Sortino); Return per unit of total volatility (Sharpe)

metrics.name: relative_strength
metrics.formula_as_implemented: ret_20d(stock) - ret_20d(SPY); score=clamp(50+relative*3)

code_reference.champion_exclusion: advisor_engine.py:207-234 (technical_score_from_parts pops this weight when short_horizon_treatment='neutral', settings.json top-level key)

metrics.source_field: daily close price history (stock + SPY benchmark)
metrics.weight_defined_at: settings.json:market_behavior.weights.relative_strength (NOMINAL; overridden to 0 effective by short_horizon_treatment='neutral' on the champion path)
metrics.missing_value_behavior: excluded from champion blend entirely by design (not merely on missing data)
metrics.note: settings.json:1299 comment: Spearman +1.00 rank-correlated with return_20d by construction, was 'drawing 16% of this blend for a signal already present' -- this is why short_horizon_treatment defaults to neutral

metrics.name: drawdown_resilience
metrics.formula_as_implemented: drawdown_score(max_drawdown_252d) = 100/(1+depth), depth=|min(0,dd)|/25; falls back to 60d peak-relative drawdown if <252 closes
metrics.display_tooltip: Deepest peak-to-trough fall over the past year

metrics.name: volume_confirmation
metrics.formula_as_implemented: up-day/down-day volume ratio over trailing 60 sessions, capped at 3.0; score=clamp(35+(ratio-1)*55)
metrics.fallback_chain: None if <21 sessions or length mismatch
metrics.display_tooltip: Volume on up days against down days - under 1 means rallies are unconvinced

metrics.name: low_beta
metrics.formula_as_implemented: 100/(1+distance^2), distance=|beta-0.85|/0.55 (rewards beta near 0.85, not minimal beta; betting-against-beta)
metrics.source_field: info.beta (Yahoo) or OLS beta vs SPY from return history
metrics.fallback_chain: beta_vs_benchmark OLS computation if info.beta missing
metrics.period_convention: n/a (point value) / trailing return series for OLS fallback
metrics.direction: higher_is_better (as a score; the raw beta itself has a non-monotonic 'ideal' of 0.85, not simply lower-is-better)
metrics.display_tooltip: Sensitivity to the broad market - the link between the Fed backdrop and this name

metrics.name: technical_extended
metrics.formula_as_implemented: equal-weighted average of moving_average_slope, RSI, bollinger_percent_b, on_balance_volume_slope, whichever resolve
metrics.normalization: 4 independent fixed formulas, no reference population
metrics.missing_value_behavior: dropped, remaining sub-weights renormalized; if none resolve, entire market_behavior technical_extended term drops
metrics.display_label: not directly labeled in src/ -- UNDETERMINED

metrics.name: news_sentiment
metrics.formula_as_implemented: weighted avg article sentiment (recency*source_quality*content_type*entity_confidence weights, 3-day half-life, 7-day window); score=clamp(50+average*100); returns None (not 50) if nothing clears filters
metrics.source_provider: Marketaux (primary), RSS (fallback per fetch_news.py, not read this session)
metrics.fallback_chain: Marketaux -> RSS (per FILE_INVENTORY.md's description of fetch_news.py, not independently verified this session)
metrics.normalization: deterministic weighted average, no cross-sectional reference
metrics.missing_value_behavior: drops from composite blend entirely (renormalized among fundamentals/market_behavior), not defaulted to neutral 50
metrics.display_label: UNDETERMINED -- no dedicated glossary entry found in MetricSections.jsx this session

metrics.name: forward_eps_revision_30d
metrics.formula_as_implemented: pct change in consensus FY1 EPS over 30 calendar days; revision_score=clamp(50+revision*5,0,100)
metrics.source_provider: estimate_provider (per metric_registry.json preferred_providers; no free estimate provider currently wired per scoring_v2.py:213-217's own unavailable_reason text)
metrics.fallback_chain: none; publishes null, not a neutral value, when unresolved
metrics.effective_weight_in_composite: N/A (shadow-only layer, not part of the published composite score)
metrics.missing_value_behavior: publishes null with an explicit unavailable_reason string; layer coverage 0.0 rather than a fabricated 50
metrics.display_label: UNDETERMINED (AnalysisLayers.jsx not read line-by-line this session)

metrics.name: earnings_surprise_timeliness
metrics.formula_as_implemented: surprise_score=clamp(50+surprise*2,0,100), reusing the SAME raw earnings_surprise field as the fundamentals/growth metric but a different transform
metrics.source_field: same as fundamentals earnings_surprise (derived from yfinance earnings_dates)
metrics.period_convention: trailing quarterly, weighted (inherited from the fundamentals derivation)
metrics.missing_value_behavior: publishes null, layer coverage reflects only 2 possible inputs
metrics.note: distinct entry from the fundamentals-layer earnings_surprise metric above -- same raw value, two independent scoring transforms in two layers
